6. 圖中所示為 $y = a(x + b)^2$ 的圖像，其中 $a$ 及 $b$ 均為常數。下列何者正確？
A. $a > 0$ 及 $b > 0$
B. $a > 0$ 及 $b < 0$
C. $a < 0$ 及 $b > 0$
D. $a < 0$ 及 $b < 0$
reasoning: The parabola in the diagram opens downward, so its coefficient $a$ must be negative ($a<0$). The vertex is positioned to the left of the y‑axis, meaning $-b<0$, which implies $b>0$. Therefore $a<0$ and $b>0$, corresponding to option C.
